RcppOptimLib RcppOptimLib-package
RcppOptimLib: An Interface to the C++ Numerical Optimization Library 'OptimLib'

Optimizing R functions

Wrappers that minimize plain R functions via callbacks into OptimLib.

optimlib_bfgs()
Minimize an R function with BFGS via callbacks
optimlib_nm()
Minimize an R function with Nelder-Mead via callbacks

C++ objective demonstrations

Objectives written entirely in C++; the model for packages using LinkingTo: RcppOptimLib.

optim_sphere_bfgs()
Minimize the sphere function with BFGS (C++ objective)
optim_ackley_de()
Minimize the Ackley function with Differential Evolution (C++ objective)
